title: Suicide Squad Isekai
description: In the crime-ridden city of Gotham, Amanda Waller, the head of A.R.G.U.S., assembles a group of notorious criminals—Harley Quinn, Deadshot, Peacemaker, Clayface and King Shark—for a mission into an otherworldly realm that’s connected to this world through a gate. It’s a realm of swords and magic where orcs rampage and dragons rule the skies. Can Harley Quinn and her crew conquer this perilous realm?

episodes_data.title: Suicide Squad Isekai Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: "A new world" – After going on a rampage with her partner-in-crime, The Joker, Harley Quinn is sent straight to Belle Reve Penitentiary.

episodes_data.title: Suicide Squad Isekai Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Harley Quinn, Deadshot, Peacemaker, Clayface and King Shark find themselves in a new world of swords and sorcery, known as an "ISEKAI."

episodes_data.title: Suicide Squad Isekai Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Harley Quinn and the Suicide Squad strike a deal with Queen Aldora of the Kingdom to deactivate the bombs in their necks.

episodes_data.title: Suicide Squad Isekai Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: The war between the Kingdom and the Empire has been raging for decades. Hoping to end the carnage, Princess Fione enlists Harley and her team's help.

episodes_data.title: Suicide Squad Isekai Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Taking on Ratcatcher's army of beasts turns out to be a piece of cake for the Suicide Squad.

episodes_data.title: Suicide Squad Isekai Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Harley and the Suicide Squad triumphantly return from dragon-slaying when they find a blazing fortress and a heartbreaking defeat.

episodes_data.title: Suicide Squad Isekai Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: To stop the Suicide Squad from resetting their bombs, Thinker has his elf army build a fortress near the gate.

episodes_data.title: Suicide Squad Isekai Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Back in the royal capital after their epic triumph, the Suicide Squad are in for a rude awakening.

episodes_data.title: Suicide Squad Isekai Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: The shocking truth about the Undead King is revealed! Princess Fione is devastated to learn the truth, but when Harley drops some truth bombs, it's game on!

episodes_data.title: Suicide Squad Isekai Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Things look dire when Lich's undead army rolls in and starts wrecking the Kingdom.
